display.purpose: Page titles (Library, Settings) and the 1.8rem sidebar brand name.

label.purpose: Uppercase small-caps metadata: stat headings, table headers, status heading.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: The system's only shadow: marks input focus, paired with a border-color shift to Case File Indigo.

motion.name: checkmark-pulse
motion.purpose: Inline confirmation that a field auto-saved.

motion.name: hover-fill
motion.purpose: Nav links and the ghost/helper button hover-fill transition.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single reserved gradient action per screen (e.g. Scan Library).
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { border: none; border-radius: 14px; padding: 11px 18px; color: #fff; font-weight: 700; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #5b7cff, #7c3aed); cursor: pointer; }

components.name: Ghost/Helper Button
components.description: Secondary action (e.g. Resolve SteamID64) using a translucent indigo fill instead of the full gradient.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { border: none; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 16px; background: rgba(91, 124, 255, 0.2); color: #93a9ff; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.9rem; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(91, 124, 255, 0.3); }

components.name: Stat Tile / Card
components.description: Bordered card used for stat tiles, panels, and the settings form.
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid #243244; border-radius: 14px; padding: 12px 14px; background: #111a25; } .ds-card h2 { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 0.82rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #94a3b8; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Form field with sunken background and reserved-accent focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #0f1722; border: 1px solid #2b3a4d; color: #e5e7eb; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #5b7cff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(91, 124, 255, 0.2); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(91, 124, 255, 0.16); color: #93a9ff; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Link
components.description: Sidebar navigation item with hover/active tonal fills.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { color: #cbd5e1; text-decoration: none; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 10px; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { background: #182230; } .ds-nav-link--active { background: #1b2736; color: #ffffff; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Games Table
components.description: Signature dense data table: fixed layout, uppercase headers, tabular numerals, row hover.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; table-layout: fixed; border-collapse: collapse; } .ds-table th, .ds-table td { text-align: left; border-bottom: 1px solid #223041; padding: 12px 10px; } .ds-table thead th { color: #94a3b8; font-size: 0.82rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background: #16212e; }

narrative.overview: Liberarme reads like case files, not a dashboard: dark, procedural, unshowy. Every screen exists to help someone verify a fact about a game they own, so the interface stays out of the way of the record it's showing. The voice is utilitarian and technical: dense tables, small-caps labels, tabular numerals, no hand-holding copy. The one deliberate accent, a narrow indigo-to-violet gradient, is reserved for the small number of primary actions and brand marks that deserve attention, and it must stay rare. The system explicitly rejects reading as a generic SaaS dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black, low-chroma backgrounds with a single warm-blue/violet accent used sparingly
Zero box-shadows; hierarchy comes from background luminance steps and 1px borders
Tabular numerals and fixed-layout tables for scannable data

rules.name: The One Gradient Rule
rules.body: The indigo-to-violet gradient appears only on the primary call-to-action button and the brand mark. It never becomes a card background, header treatment, or decorative fill.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. The only shadow in the system is the input focus-ring glow.

rules.name: The Small-Caps Metadata Rule
rules.body: Anything describing data about data is uppercase, letter-spaced, and muted. Anything that is the data stays normal case and full-contrast.

dos: Do keep the accent gradient to one primary action and the brand mark per screen.
Do build hierarchy through background luminance steps and 1px borders, not shadows.
Do set metadata labels in small-caps, letter-spaced, muted type.
Do use tabular numerals and fixed table layout for new data tables.
donts: Don't let the accent gradient spread to card backgrounds, section headers, or decorative fills.
Don't introduce box-shadows for card elevation or button emphasis.
Don't mix in a second typeface for personality.
